1. Executive Summary

This document supersedes AI Rollout Plan v1.0 (April 2026). It reflects the actual state of the AI program as of May 2026: three Claude.ai Projects live and shipping to a named 5-person Phase 1 cohort, plus the Cowork-side build/maintenance system Adam uses to construct and maintain the projects.

Phase 1 of the rollout focuses on getting five named staff members fully active across the three live tools (AI Advisor, STA Support Chat, STA Salesforce Cohort) over a 1-2 week window. System integrations (Gmail, Salesforce MCP) remain deferred to Phase 3 per the original plan.

What changed since v1.0: the tool inventory is largely rebuilt. Document Maker was deprecated. Task Scheduler was retired and absorbed into per-project scheduling. STA Support Chat reached Active. STA Salesforce Cohort was built and is shipping with this rollout. AI Advisor reached production v1.14 with a 100/100 eval score. The cohort definition narrowed from "all 10 staff" to a deliberate 5-person Phase 1 group with clear tool-to-person mapping.

2. Platform Overview: Claude Teams

What Is Claude Teams?

Claude Teams is the enterprise subscription tier of Claude, Anthropic's AI assistant. The Teams tier includes specific data privacy guarantees and administrative controls relevant to a business environment - including a contractual commitment that conversations are not used to train Anthropic models, a Data Processing Agreement, and admin controls for user provisioning and shared projects.

How Claude Handles Your Data

When a user types a message into Claude, the message is sent to Anthropic's infrastructure, processed, and a response is returned. The mechanics relevant to our deployment:

  • Claude does not retain memory between separate conversations by default. Each new chat session starts fresh.

  • Claude Teams does NOT use organization conversations to train future AI models. This is contractual under the Teams tier.

  • Data sent to Claude is transmitted to Anthropic's servers, which means it leaves School Technology's internal systems. This is why the Restricted Data policy exists.

  • Persistent context is provided through shared Projects: uploaded context files and project instructions that load with every conversation in that project. These are visible to all members of the project.

Teams Tier Facts

Feature

Detail

Data Training

Anthropic does not train AI models on Teams customer data. Contractual.

Admin Visibility

Admins can view usage statistics and billing. Admins CANNOT read conversation content.

Data Retention

Conversation data is retained for a limited period for abuse monitoring per the Anthropic DPA.

Admin Controls

Organization-wide settings, user management, and shared project administration.

Project Sharing

Claude.ai Projects can be shared with named team members or the whole organization.

Pricing

Per-seat subscription. Minimum 5 seats.

5. HR and Sensitive Data - Special Handling

Tanya Ballard's Controller role includes financial data oversight; the Hoerl family handles executive HR matters. While there is no dedicated HR person in the 5-person Phase 1 cohort, the HR-Specific Restricted Data section of the AI Restricted Data Reference Guide applies to Tanya's use of any AI tool when she is working with employee compensation, performance, or benefits data.

Admin Visibility and Privacy

Claude Teams: the IT administrator (Adam, or any other admin) CANNOT view the content of conversations users have inside their projects. Admins can see usage statistics and billing data only. This is the privacy baseline under which sensitive HR/financial use is permitted - subject always to the restricted data rules below.

Restricted Data - Financial / HR Context

The following categories of data are restricted and must not be entered into Claude in identifiable form:

  • Social Security Numbers: Never enter full or partial SSNs. Use a placeholder ("Employee A") if context requires reference.

  • Specific Named Employee Salaries: Aggregate analysis or drafting is acceptable. Specific named salaries are restricted.

  • Health and Benefits Information: Medical conditions, FMLA requests, disability accommodations, or health insurance details must be anonymized before use.

  • Performance and Disciplinary Records: Use role descriptions rather than names ("a customer support employee" rather than the staff member's name).

  • Government-Issued IDs: Driver's license numbers, passport numbers, I-9 identification details - never enter these.

Anonymization Examples

Instead of entering this...

Enter this instead...

"John Smith's salary is $72,000 and he is requesting a raise"

"An employee with 3 years tenure is requesting a salary review. Help me think through the framework."

"Jane Doe is on FMLA for a cardiac condition"

"An employee has submitted an FMLA request for a serious health condition. Draft a confidential response template."

"Employee SSN: 123-45-6789"

Do not enter SSNs in any form. Reference the employee by role or anonymized identifier.

"Mike was written up for attendance in March"

"Help me draft a second written warning for a recurring attendance issue."



6. Security Risks and Mitigations

Risk summary across the AI deployment, with mitigations in place or planned.

Risk

Description

Mitigation

Data Sent to External Servers

All content typed into Claude is transmitted to Anthropic's infrastructure.

Restricted Data policy, staff training, AUP acknowledgment before account activation.

Training Data Ingestion

Some AI tiers use conversations to improve models.

Claude Teams tier: Anthropic does not train on customer data. Contractual.

Data Retention

Prompts and responses retained on Anthropic servers for limited periods.

Teams DPA defines retention limits. Reviewed annually.

Prompt Injection (future Gmail integration)

Malicious email content could embed instructions attempting to manipulate Claude's behavior.

Read-only Gmail access during pilot. No auto-send. Restricted Data policy applied to email content.

Overpermissioned Integrations

OAuth integrations often request broader access than needed.

IT reviews and approves all OAuth scopes before any integration is enabled. Documented in Google/Salesforce Access Security Checklists.

Shadow AI / Unauthorized Tools

Staff may use personal or free AI tools outside sanctioned ones.

AUP defines approved tools. Phase 1 onboarding includes "use the sanctioned tools, escalate gaps to Adam."

Credential Entry

Staff might enter passwords, API keys, or login credentials.

Explicit prohibition in AUP and Restricted Data List. Reinforced in every per-tool brief.

HR / Financial Data Exposure

Tanya's role includes sensitive financial / HR-adjacent data.

Section 5 anonymization rules. Tanya has direct training on the restricted data list.

Vendor Risk

Anthropic, as a third-party vendor, could be subject to breach or service changes.

Data Processing Agreement. Monitoring of Anthropic security disclosures.

AI Output Errors

AI tools can produce wrong answers; risk of sending bad info to a customer.

NEVER FABRICATE rule built into STA Support Chat and STA Salesforce Cohort. Source-label taxonomy on every answer. All drafts reviewed before sending - user is responsible for what goes out under their name.



Incident Response

If restricted data disclosure is suspected or confirmed:

  • Staff member reports the incident to Adam immediately (adamb@k12sta.com)

  • Adam documents the nature of the disclosure (what data, what was entered, approximate time, which tool)

  • Adam evaluates whether a formal data breach notification is required

  • If an integration was involved: Adam revokes integration access immediately pending investigation

  • Adam contacts Anthropic to request data deletion if applicable

  • Incident is logged and reviewed for policy updates
